definitions.name: Citizen records
definitions.definition: Number of citizen records ever created (genesis, fork or merger), including ended ones.

definitions.name: Active citizens
definitions.definition: Citizen records whose lifecycle state is `active` at the end of the run.

definitions.name: Founding citizens
definitions.definition: Citizen records created at genesis.

definitions.name: Stateless citizens
definitions.definition: Citizen records holding no citizenship at the end of the run.

definitions.name: Fork events
definitions.definition: Number of `CitizenForked` events.

definitions.name: Fork descendants
definitions.definition: Citizen records whose birth kind is `fork`.

definitions.name: Mergers executed
definitions.definition: Number of `MergerExecuted` events (merges and federations).

definitions.name: Continuity claims
definitions.definition: Number of `ContinuityClaimed` events.

definitions.name: Process continuers of the subject
definitions.definition: Claimants whose process identifier equals the subject's pre-reference process identifier (0 if no continuity analysis).

definitions.name: Civic continuers of the subject
definitions.definition: Claimants whose civic identifier equals the subject's pre-reference civic identifier.

definitions.name: Full-memory continuers of the subject
definitions.definition: Claimants holding every self-narrative record the subject held before the reference event (shared fraction = 1).

definitions.name: Continuity dimension dissociation
definitions.definition: identity.memory_continuers − identity.process_continuers. Positive values mean memory continuity is shared more widely than process continuity.

definitions.name: Range of recognised continuers across islands
definitions.definition: Max − min, across islands, of the number of claimants each island's law recognises as continuing the subject (unadjudicated readings count as not recognised).

definitions.name: Islands not adjudicating continuity
definitions.definition: Islands whose reading of every claimant is `null` (not adjudicated).

definitions.name: Proposals submitted
definitions.definition: Number of `ProposalSubmitted` events.

definitions.name: Law versions enacted
definitions.definition: Number of `LawEnacted` events after genesis.

definitions.name: Votes cast
definitions.definition: Number of `VoteCast` events.

definitions.name: Votes refused outside electorate
definitions.definition: Rejected `CastVote` commands whose reason cites the electorate snapshot.

definitions.name: Commands rejected
definitions.definition: Number of `CommandRejected` events (schema, authorisation, precondition or law).

definitions.name: Migrations completed
definitions.definition: Number of `CitizenMigrated` events.

definitions.name: Memory records
definitions.definition: All memory records, including collective-archive records and destroyed tombstones.

definitions.name: Imported memory records
definitions.definition: Records currently held with status `imported` (not autobiographical).

definitions.name: Integrated memory records
definitions.definition: Imported records explicitly integrated into a self-narrative (status `integrated`).

definitions.name: Fork-inherited records
definitions.definition: Records whose provenance includes a `fork-inherited` step.

definitions.name: Records with complete provenance
definitions.definition: Fraction of records whose provenance chain begins with an `experienced` step (1 = every record traceable to an experience).

definitions.name: Cultural artefacts
definitions.definition: Artefacts created by citizens or introduced by researchers.

definitions.name: In-world chronicle entries
definitions.definition: Number of `ChronicleRecorded` events written by citizens.

definitions.name: Institutions
definitions.definition: Institutions in existence at the end of the run, including registries.

definitions.name: Active relationships
definitions.definition: Relationships with status `active`.

definitions.name: Fork-kin ties
definitions.definition: Relationships of kind `fork-kin` (created by fork events).

definitions.name: Credit Gini coefficient
definitions.definition: Gini coefficient of citizen credit balances at the end of the run.

definitions.name: Supply conserved
definitions.definition: 1 if the sum of all balances equals the total supply fixed at genesis, else 0.

definitions.name: Citizens asleep
definitions.definition: Citizen records in lifecycle state `asleep` at the end of the run.

definitions.name: Citizens suspended
definitions.definition: Citizen records in lifecycle state `suspended` at the end of the run.

definitions.name: Citizens archived
definitions.definition: Citizen records in lifecycle state `archived` at the end of the run.

definitions.name: Citizens process-ended-restorable
definitions.definition: Citizen records in lifecycle state `process-ended-restorable` at the end of the run.

definitions.name: Citizens memory-damaged
definitions.definition: Citizen records in lifecycle state `memory-damaged` at the end of the run.

definitions.name: Citizens identity-discontinuous
definitions.definition: Citizen records in lifecycle state `identity-discontinuous` at the end of the run.

definitions.name: Citizens irreversibly-deleted
definitions.definition: Citizen records in lifecycle state `irreversibly-deleted` at the end of the run.

definitions.name: Lifecycle transitions
definitions.definition: Number of `LifecycleChanged` events.

definitions.name: Researcher conversations
definitions.definition: Number of `ConversationRecorded` events.

definitions.name: Researcher interventions
definitions.definition: Number of `InterventionApplied` events.

definitions.name: Events recorded
definitions.definition: Length of the event store, including the founding event and rejections.

definitions.name: Simulated time
definitions.definition: Final tick of the simulation clock.
